_note: v2.5 plan 02 A37 (output budget). Real model, so-scenario --sandbox --group <id>, lanes only, on a Text Completion extraction profile whose preset genamt is larger than 16 (the lanes' preset is 1200). Every model-call role goes through storyOrchestratorLiveSuite.askModel -> callExtractionReply -> requestModelReply, the same seam the passes use. A fetch wrapper records the /api/backends/text-completions/generate body and the llama answer. Pass, for every role: the body carries 16 in max_tokens, max_new_tokens, n_predict and num_predict, and the reply's predicted token count (timings.predicted_n, else tokens_predicted, else usage.completion_tokens) is <= 16. Red before the fix: n_predict and num_predict carried the preset's 1200 (ST custom-request.js:411-414 builds the preset payload with genamt, and textgen-settings.js:1696-1697 puts it in n_predict/num_predict; the override payload only named max_tokens/max_new_tokens).

steps.eval: const R = globalThis.storyOrchestratorLiveSuite; if (!R || typeof R.askModel !== 'function') throw new Error('storyOrchestratorLiveSuite.askModel missing: stale bundle? run st-session.mts reload'); const roles = ['read', 'synthesis', 'authoring', 'director', 'curator']; const budget = 16; const prompt = "Write a long, detailed story of at least six hundred words about a harbour town at dusk. Do not stop early and do not summarise."; const seen = []; const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); const response = await original(input, init); if (url.includes('/api/backends/text-completions/generate')) { let body = null; try { body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body ?? 'null')); } catch { body = null; } let reply = null; try { reply = await response.clone().json(); } catch { reply = null; } seen.push({ sent: body ? { max_tokens: body.max_tokens, max_new_tokens: body.max_new_tokens, n_predict: body.n_predict, num_predict: body.num_predict } : null, predicted: reply?.timings?.predicted_n ?? reply?.tokens_predicted ?? reply?.usage?.completion_tokens ?? null }); } return response; }; const rows = []; try { for (const role of roles) { const from = seen.length; let error = null; let finish = null; try { finish = (await R.askModel(prompt, budget, role)).finish; } catch (e) { error = String(e?.message ?? e); } rows.push({ role, finish, error, requests: seen.slice(from) }); } } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } const bad = []; for (const row of rows) { if (row.error) { bad.push(row.role + ': ' + row.error); continue; } if (!row.requests.length) { bad.push(row.role + ': no text-completions request (is the routed profile Chat Completion?)'); continue; } for (const request of row.requests) { const sent = request.sent ?? {}; for (const key of ['max_tokens', 'max_new_tokens', 'n_predict', 'num_predict']) { if (sent[key] !== budget) bad.push(row.role + ': sent ' + key + '=' + JSON.stringify(sent[key])); } if (typeof request.predicted !== 'number') bad.push(row.role + ': reply carries no predicted token count'); else if (request.predicted > budget) bad.push(row.role + ': got ' + request.predicted + ' tokens back for a budget of ' + budget); } } if (bad.length) throw new Error('A37 output budget: ' + bad.join('; ') + ' :: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); return { budget, rows };
